text: In January of each year, a Notice of Appointment of Representative is received from the Royal Agricultural Winter Fair (RAWF) requesting the appointment of one representative of the Board of Governors to the RAWF. As a member association of the Royal Agricultural Winter Fair, The Board is allowed to name one representative to the Royal’s Board of Governors for the 2020 year. The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Appointed Howard Lichtman as the Board representative to the Royal Agricultural Winter Fair Association (RAWF) for the 2020 term.
